newsitem.title: CANADA: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.
newsitem.headline: Koch Oil raises Canada posted oil prices.

text.p: Koch Oil Co Ltd said it raised the price it would pay for Edmonton light sweet crude oil by C$6.00/cubic metre or C$0.95/barrel, to C$208.00/cubic metre or C$0.95/barrel, effective immediately.
Other new prices were listed as follows:
Cromer light sour C$205.00/cubic metre, or C$32.59/barrel
Bow River at Hardisty C$182.00/cubic metre, or C$28.94/barrel
Hardisty medium C$193.00/cubic metre, or C$30.68/barrel
Midale at Cromer C$194.00/cubic metre, or C$30.84/barrel
